title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Authorization bypass in saveAjaxTextarea task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3,…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla Visforms extension (versions 1.0.0-5.6.3 and 6.0.0-6.2.0) allows backend users to bypass authorization checks in the saveAjaxTextarea task. This flaw permits modification of any form configuration, including sensitive settings like notification recipients, due to lack of edit permission verification and acceptance of arbitrary table and column names.
